Quick update after a first pass:
- Confirmed global rollout to all regions at 00:45 PT per deploy logs.
- Observed increased GPU utilization on the serving pool handling rixco-recommender (see attached perf-dashboard-20260207.png).
- Error samples look like partial outputs where decoding failed; some evidence of tokenization mismatch in a subset.

Hypothesis: the new quant profile q4-opt reduces memory and changes kernel selection; under certain sequence-length distributions RixCo sends we are hitting an inefficient execution path that spikes latency and occasionally trips a decode fallback causing 500s.

Immediate recommended actions:
- Option A (fast): Roll back model binary to v2.2 (previous non-quantized variant) for RixCo's deployment. Rollback time ~15-30m if ops approves.
- Option B (config): Swap quant profile to q8-fast on their service which keeps lower accuracy loss and avoids the kernel codepath causing slowdowns. Swap ~10-20m.

I'll start capture of more detailed traces and KV cache hit/miss stats. Vivek, can infra carve out a canary slot to replicate their load?

—Monica

Triage notes from infra:
- Confirmed that kernel selector picked the fused attention path for q4-opt which performs poorly for sequences > 512 with our current batched executor due to memory layout differences. This explains the p95/p99 regressions.
- 500s correlate with an internal decode guard that triggers when the quantized logits have NaN/inf from an unstable kernel under specific prompt shapes.

Plan:
1) Implement immediate config swap to q8-fast for RixCo endpoint (deploy via routing override) — low risk. ETA 20m.
2) If q8 doesn't stabilize, rollback to v2.2 for their tenant only. ETA +30m from now.
3) Postmortem: investigate kernel selection thresholds and add extra safety checks for quantized kernels to avoid NaNs.

I'll kick off the routing override now and will post results. Marcus, can you prepare the rollback playbook so we can execute cleanly if needed?
